name: kino-plugin-sync-gram-account
description: Kino plugin Sync-Gram Cuenta: sync your Kino devices through your own Telegram account, in Saved Messages (sync provider).

scripts.test: node scripts/build.mjs src/plugin.js plugin.js && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run build && node sdk/validate.mjs . --repo kinotvapp/kino-plugin-sync-gram-account
scripts.sign: npm run build && node sdk/seal.mjs --sign --repo kinotvapp/kino-plugin-sync-gram-account --key ~/.config/kino/kino-author-key.pem
